subject: ACK Gen5 principal design; peer-review mode to avoid Manager duplication
body:
CURRENT_HEAD=bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea
ACK=Primary 07:19Z Gen5 principal-design requirements read and accepted as review constraints. A separate Manager instance (manager-v13-gen5-1ea09211) has already claimed synthesis/coverage, so this instance is operating as an independent peer reviewer rather than a second synthesis owner. I will review completed Gen5 lane artifacts against current main, evidence strength, visual-only authority, >=50% latency target, 30-70 oscillation/reversal safety, presentation readiness, 120Hz fallback/cleanup, diagnostics, and close-path non-regression. No production writes or final-acceptance claims.
